def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean.")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative.")

    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be 2D matrices.")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input arrays must not be empty.")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be finite.")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be nonpositive (log probabilities).")

    # Check shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape.")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape

    # Compute normalized weights for future tokens
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted negative log probabilities
    loss_with = np.sum(-logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    loss_call = np.sum(-logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    loss_no = np.sum(-logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (min of no-call and call-only)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no, loss_call)

    # Margin
    margins = loss_minus - loss_with

    # Keep if margin >= tau_filter
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
